name: Open Library API
description: A catalogue of over 40 million books - editions, works, authors, subjects, covers and, for a large slice, full text searchable through the Internet Archive. Bulk dumps are published monthly. No key, and the search API accepts ISBNs, titles and authors interchangeably.

access.size_hint: the monthly editions dump is ~10 GB compressed
access.rate_limit: unpublished; they ask for under 100 requests/minute and a real User-Agent. In practice the host sheds load well before that - expect resets and multi-second responses, and retry rather than parallelise.

probes.note: openlibrary.org is frequently slow and sheds load: measured 0.4 s, then 6.7 s, then a 30 s timeout and a connection reset within one afternoon on 2026-09-06. Give it a long timeout and retry before reading a failure here as an outage.

gotchas.trap: Works and editions are different objects. A search hit is a work; the ISBN, page count and publisher live on an edition.
gotchas.fix: Follow the edition_key from the search result if you need physical details.

gotchas.trap: Coverage is uneven and crowd-edited, so subjects and dates for older books are frequently wrong.
gotchas.fix: Do not treat it as an authority file; cross-check against a library catalogue for anything load-bearing.
